verdict.left_looks: A red barn with a rounded, stepped gambrel-style silhouette. The front is a red and white checkerboard with a dark wood beam canopy, hanging lanterns, a hay bale in the loft and a central dark wood post. The roof is dark gray stone brick with a cupola or vent on top. The sides are plain red with white window slits and a stone base. The sides slope inward slightly. Hay bales, barrels and a fence surround it, and there is a path to the door. The back is a large flat red wall with a stepped white battlement-like trim.
verdict.right_looks: A red barn with a simple gable roof of dark brown wood-plank stairs, with a stepped dark wood gable end. The front has a big white-framed opening with plank double doors inside. The corners are tan wood with carved-pattern pillars, and the base is a stone-brick course. The sides are plain red with white window slits. A plank fence is in front and the whole thing sits on a plank platform. The back has a stepped gable with one window hole and a small door. The roof has a clear overhang. Overall it is clean but sparse.
verdict.why: The left build has far more character and detail (checker facade, lanterns, hay, cupola, props, grass base) and reads as a lively barn, while the right is a plainer box with a bare plank base and few props, though its roof is cleaner.
